_comment: sim-station-full-brake-place-v1: the integration recipe + coldwin50 acceptance for the FULL base brake over the LOADED collect place descent. NAMED CAUSE (coldwin49, datasets .../coldwin49-shove.txt): coldwin49 reached the shelf place (PREPLACE_ABOVE_SUPPORT engaged +0.080 m above the resolved 0.9707 m shelf top, real positive descent, ZERO CARTON_TILT) but the loaded from-above descent onto the high shelf shoved the base 0.08-0.18 m SOUTH (away from the cart, a pure translational recoil), crossing the 0.080 m collect_place_base_settle_m at t=195.08 s while the carton was still ~0.22 m ABOVE the shelf (the shove starts DURING the descent, pre-contact). The base was held ONLY by the rotation-lock station hold (MOBILE_BRAKE full-rotation-lock@target(D6) [CHASSIS_STATION_PITCH_HOLD]), which deliberately leaves TRANSLATION FREE ('weld-loop relief'), so x/y recoil was unopposed; past t215 the welded carton/shelf contact went numerically unstable (carton z -> ~38 m). The stationary guard never fired a named abort -- the run died on arm_not_in_transport / 'collect stuck 120 s' because the place never completed. FIX = FULL-lock the base (translation AND rotation) over the loaded place window; collect_place_base_settle_m stays 0.080.
_shipped: An opt-in RUNTIME key station_place_full_brake that, at the collect station, FULL-locks the chassis (transX/Y/Z + rotX/Y/Z, a D6 with all six axes locked, rotation anchored at the pitch/roll hold TARGET) from the moment the arm leaves the pre-place standoff (phase 'place') through detach + empty withdraw (phases 'release','retreat'), ON TOP of the existing rotation-only CHASSIS_STATION_PITCH_HOLD, then returns to the rotation-only latched brake at stow/verify. One engage at place-start, one release at withdraw -- no cycling. Byte-identical when off. The exact lock primitive is MobileController.engage_station_full_lock (a sibling of the pre-weld engage_base_full_brake and the rotation-only engage_brake). Logs MOBILE_BRAKE engaged/released with the DOFs locked.
_weld_loop_safety: With the base fully locked, the welded carton/arm/base loop (world->base->arm->weld->carton->shelf->world) can fight when the carton meets the shelf. It is bounded three ways: (1) the contact-triggered weld release (place_contact_release, PR 333) fires at FIRST contact and OPENS the loop, so the loop is closed only for the instant between contact and release; (2) the sensor leveller authority stays bounded (unchanged); (3) station_place_full_brake_effort_limit arms an effort guard (isaac_port._station_full_brake_monitor) that logs STATION_FULL_BRAKE_EFFORT during the locked window and, on an over-limit arm-joint-effort spike for N consecutive ticks, ABORTS to a HOLD -- it keeps the base full-braked and holds the arm (the controlled-stop path), NEVER releasing the lock (which would let the loop shove the base). WHY translation was previously free: the yaw-lock-only brake left translation free so a rigid full lock would not over-constrain the loop while the welded carton rests on a support (run-208/209 oscillated the arm). WHY it is safe to lock it for THIS bounded window: the from-above descent closes the loop only at the shelf, the contact release opens it immediately, and the effort guard HOLDs (never shoves) if the release does not fire -- so the loop is never held closed+rigid long enough to fight.
_integration_lane_steps: 1. Copy the coldwin49 mission RUNTIME config to your own dir (do NOT hand-edit the integration lane's ~/datasets configs). It already has chassis_station_pitch_hold: true, collect_place_base_settle_m: 0.08, mobile_manifest -> mobile-casterlift030. Keep all of that.
2. Add the station_place_full_brake RUNTIME keys below to that config (top-level; physics_setup.assemble reads them).

3. config_preflight: scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/config_preflight.py --host-config <host.json> --runtime-config <your runtime.json> [--place-on-deck --support-top-z-world 0.9707 --mobile-manifest <manifest>]. It REFUSES station_place_full_brake set without chassis_station_pitch_hold, and refuses a non-positive effort limit (check_station_full_brake). Expect CONFIG_PREFLIGHT: PASS.

4. Run the bounded collect proof as coldwin50: run_mobile_restock.py ... (the coldwin49 side-bay cycle), serialized through /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, HEAVY_MB=2500 if whispr holds VRAM, renice +10, never --force. This lane proves on CPU; the GPU belongs to the integration lane.

5. In the log, confirm: 'STATION_PLACE_FULL_BRAKE enabled' at assemble; one 'MOBILE_BRAKE engaged (full-D6 lock transX,transY,transZ,rotX,rotY,rotZ @target...)' at the place-descent start and one 'MOBILE_BRAKE released (full-D6 lock)' at withdraw (not cycling); BASE_YAW_TICK base_dxy staying small (< ~20 mm) through place/release/retreat; a PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE at the true shelf top; verify_place passing. If STATION_FULL_BRAKE_ABORT appears, the weld loop fought past the effort limit -- raise it (or confirm the contact release fired) from the STATION_FULL_BRAKE_EFFORT peaks.

runtime_config_keys._note: ALL RUNTIME (physics_setup.assemble reads them). Merge into the coldwin49 runtime config ALONGSIDE the existing chassis_station_pitch_hold + collect_place_base_settle_m. station_place_full_brake REQUIRES chassis_station_pitch_hold (the full lock anchors at its pitch/roll target; config_preflight enforces this). station_place_full_brake_effort_limit is OPTIONAL (absent => the full lock still engages, but the weld-loop effort guard + its logging are inert); set it to arm the guard. 600 N.m is a conservative START above a normal loaded UR10 place (~250 N.m FK) and below a runaway -- TUNE it from the first run's STATION_FULL_BRAKE_EFFORT peaks.

_acceptance_coldwin50.base_drift_during_descent_m: <= 0.02 (the measured base xy excursion from the place_approach anchor through place/release/retreat; coldwin49 was 0.08-0.18 m under the yaw-lock-only brake)
_acceptance_coldwin50.place_contact_release: PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE fires at TRUE shelf contact (carton bottom at the resolved 0.9707 m shelf top), not mid-air and not never
_acceptance_coldwin50.verify_place: passes with the carton resting on the shelf (not fallen; verify_place xy within tol, bottom_gap ~0)
_acceptance_coldwin50.carton_tilt_peak_deg: <= 1.5 (well inside the captain's 2.0 deg / 0.15 s bound, which is unchanged)
_acceptance_coldwin50.run_advances_past_collect: the mission proceeds to couple/outbound instead of arm_not_in_transport_timeout / 'collect stuck 120 s'

_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_station_full_brake.py (window predicate; brake state machine on a mock mobile -- lock at standoff, unlock after withdraw, rotation-only restored, no cycling; the coldwin49 shove-timeline replay showing the 0.08-0.746 m shove exceeds the 0.080 guard and lies entirely inside the place/release/retreat lock window; the effort-guard HOLD abort path; config_preflight validation) + the pxr-gated USD authoring in test_mobile_assets.py (all six axes locked at the target attitude; mutual exclusion with the rotation-only hold; released by a drive). test_restock_physics_port.py::test_base_brake_phase_aware... was repaired (it predated the station_pitch_hold branch).
_out_of_scope: GPU runs (never take /tmp/aile-gpu.lock), the 2.0 deg bound + 0.15 s grace, carton dimensions, the tow lanes, the caster suspension, collect_place_base_settle_m (stays 0.080). Delete nothing under ~/datasets.
